description:
Upload a small attachment for outbound email, as base64 text.

        Meant for small files (under about 50 KB): every base64 character goes
        through the tool call itself. Larger files go through ``create_file_upload``
        with ``purpose="email_attachment"``: its ``curl`` line sends the bytes, and its
        ``id`` works in ``send_email``'s ``attachment_ids``.
        Returns ``id``, ``filename``, ``content_type`` and ``size_bytes``.
        The ID is accepted in an email's ``attachment_ids`` and is reusable across sends.
        Unused uploads expire after 24 hours.
        The combined message and attachments must fit the 25 MB sending limit.

content_type.description: The file's MIME type, such as ``application/pdf``.
content_type.title: Content Type

filename.description: File name shown to recipients, such as ``invoice.pdf``.
filename.title: Filename

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

name: upload_email_attachment

anyOf.description:
Returned by POST /email-attachments.

``id`` is reusable across many ``POST /emails`` calls via
``EmailCreate.attachment_ids`` until Hail garbage-collects it (24h
if never referenced by a send).

content_type.description: MIME type of the uploaded file.
content_type.title: Content Type

filename.description: Original filename of the uploaded file.
filename.title: Filename

id.title: Id

size_bytes.description: Size of the uploaded file in bytes.
size_bytes.title: Size Bytes
